# Zaya — Web & App Development (ezaya.dev)

> Portfolio of Zaya, an AI-Native Product Engineer based in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.
> I design and build websites and apps for small businesses — "a face that gets
> chosen, and systems that make daily busywork disappear." I work in Japanese,
> Mongolian, and English, and stay with clients past launch.

## What I offer

- Launch Website (¥30,000–88,000, 1–2 weeks): a focused one-page site for small shops.
- Business Website (¥130,000–300,000, 3–5 weeks): multi-page, multilingual sites with booking/inquiry flows and CMS.
- Business System / App (from ¥400,000): custom systems — bookings, staff, billing, login, admin dashboards, mobile apps.
- Ongoing care available (from ¥5,000/month).

## Selected work

- OdooTech Time — attendance app for OdooTech LLC (Flutter + Odoo 17, GPS geofencing, device binding). Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- OdooTech Corporate Site — official website of Mongolia's Odoo partner (Next.js static export, custom design system): https://odootech-website.vercel.app/
- Overland Beyond — multilingual luxury-expedition travel site (Odoo → Next.js rebuild): https://overlandbeyond.com/
- Zaza Lab — free JLPT N1/N2 study PWA (1,800+ kanji with meanings, SRS review). Built and used for my own N1: passed with 171/180 (vocabulary 60/60).
